```{r}
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc <- Seurat::FindClusters(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
                               resolution       = c(2,2.5,3),
                               group.singletons = FALSE,
                               graph.name       = paste0("sNN_", "pca.SCT", "_", 30))

Idents(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc) <- "sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.3"
x <- FindMarkers(object = mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, "18", "7")

```

```{r}
FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, c("Ar")  ,split.by = "sample.name",reduction = "umap.nn",pt.size = 0.1, order = T)&scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo")&RestoreLegend()
FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, c("Tpbg")  ,split.by = "sample.name",reduction = "umap.nn",pt.size = 0.1, order = T)&scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo", limits = c(0,2))&RestoreLegend()

FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, c("Mir22hg")  ,split.by = "sample.name",reduction = "umap.nn",pt.size = 0.1, order = T)&scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo")&RestoreLegend()
FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, c("Lef1")  ,split.by = "sample.name",reduction = "umap.nn",pt.size = 0.1, order = T)&scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo")&RestoreLegend()
```
